caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, indicating the use of pencil or charcoal on a light, almost off-white background. The teapot is positioned in the center of the image, viewed from the side, and features a rounded body resting on four small, spherical feet. The lid of the teapot is slightly domed with a decorative finial at the top. The handle, located on the left, is ornate and appears dark and solid, with a pronounced angle at the top. The spout, on the right, is long, slender, and curves outward and upward gracefully. Around the midsection of the teapot's body, there is an embossed band with a decorative pattern that includes interwoven or leaf-like motifs. The shading and highlights on the teapot give it a metallic appearance, suggesting it is made of polished metal. The overall composition is balanced with the entire teapot and its details occupying the central portion of the drawing space, with ample blank space surrounding it.
title: Teapot
